title: Trace execution evidence into a defensive decision
description: Switch scenarios to see why command completion, telemetry collection, analytic matching, and analyst response are separate stages. Select a component to inspect its responsibility.

nodes.label: Authorized operator
nodes.detail: Defines the hypothesis, approved target group, maintenance window, stop conditions, and evidence that will count as a pass.

nodes.label: Simulation controller
nodes.detail: Schedules reviewed abilities or tests, records ground-truth timestamps and correlation IDs, and stops when a safety boundary is crossed.

nodes.label: Approved agent group
nodes.detail: Contains only the hosts authorized for the operation. Group membership and concurrency limits constrain the immediate blast radius.

nodes.label: Test host
nodes.detail: Runs the bounded technique implementation and cleanup. A zero exit status proves only that the command completed under its executor contract.

nodes.label: Endpoint sensor
nodes.detail: Collects process, script, file, registry, or other behavior evidence with timestamps and host identity. Sensor health is part of the test result.

nodes.label: Analytics pipeline
nodes.detail: Ingests telemetry and simulation ground truth, applies the intended analytic, and preserves enough context to explain why an alert did or did not fire.

nodes.label: SOC workflow
nodes.detail: Receives the alert, acknowledges it, follows the tested runbook, records containment decisions, and closes the evidence loop with the operator.

scenarios.label: Evidence correlated
scenarios.summary: The bounded behavior completes, the endpoint sensor records it, the analytic matches telemetry to operation ground truth, and the SOC acknowledges the alert.
scenarios.result: The team can claim a detection-and-response pass for this exact test, target, sensor state, analytic version, and runbook. It cannot generalize that result to every implementation of the ATT&CK technique.

scenarios.label: Sensor gap
scenarios.summary: The technique implementation completes on the approved host, but the endpoint sensor is unhealthy and no behavior telemetry reaches analytics.
scenarios.result: Execution passed, visibility failed, and detection is untested. Treating the controller's success status as a detection pass would hide the sensor coverage gap.

scenarios.label: Analytic gap
scenarios.summary: The host behavior is visible and searchable, but the intended analytic does not match or produce the expected alert context.
scenarios.result: Visibility passed and detection failed. Preserve the raw event, correlation ID, analytic version, and expected condition so the detection owner can reproduce the miss.

scenarios.label: Response gap
scenarios.summary: The alert fires with the expected evidence, but it is not acknowledged or handled within the rehearsal objective.
scenarios.result: Detection passed and response failed. The next fix belongs to routing, ownership, staffing, or the runbook rather than to the endpoint analytic itself.
